adminJudging.title: FOA judging rounds
adminJudging.lead: Configure rounds, invite judges, admit entries and manage assignments.
adminJudging.name: Round name (required)
adminJudging.competitionDefault: Use the competition’s FOA final scheme
adminJudging.physicalRule: Only FOA-verified entries whose physical artworks are ready can enter this round.
adminJudging.digitalRule: Only FOA-verified entries can enter this round.
adminJudging.selectEntries: Choose entries (leave all unticked to assign every eligible entry)

outcomes.flagged: Conflict recorded; any assignment for this pair was removed.
outcomes.invalid_input: Please check the information you entered.
outcomes.rubric_missing: Every enabled discipline needs a published rubric before a round can be created or opened.
outcomes.name_taken: Another round of this competition already has this name.
outcomes.round_not_editable: Only draft rounds can be edited.
outcomes.pool_not_empty: The physical-artwork rule and entry source cannot change once entries are admitted.
outcomes.round_transition_not_allowed: The round cannot move to that status.
outcomes.not_found: The round or record was not found.
outcomes.judge_not_ready: This judge has not completed their onboarding.
outcomes.already_judge: This account is already a judge for the round.
outcomes.second_factor_required: Pass the staff second factor before continuing.
outcomes.failed: We could not complete your request. Please try again.
outcomes.round_not_open: Only an open round can be locked.
outcomes.round_not_locked: Only a locked round can have tagged outcomes.
outcomes.no_assignments: Assign and score entries before locking, or ask an admin to override.
outcomes.unscored_assignments: The round is not ready to lock. Some assigned sheets are incomplete or no longer eligible.
outcomes.override_reason_invalid: Enter an override reason of 10 to 500 characters.
outcomes.invalid_outcomes: Choose a valid outcome and award for a ranked entry.
outcomes.source_is_self: A round cannot take its own finalists.
outcomes.source_not_found: Choose a source round in the same competition.
outcomes.source_cancelled: The source round was cancelled. Choose another source.
outcomes.source_not_locked: Wait for the source round to lock before opening or admitting entries.
outcomes.chain_cycle: That source would create a loop of judging rounds.
outcomes.outcome_already_advanced: This entry has already advanced to another live round. Its advancing outcome cannot be withdrawn.
outcomes.results_published: Judging rounds and outcomes cannot change after results are published.

adminJudging.rankingsClosed: Rankings are available after a round opens for judging.
adminJudging.rankingRule: Complete score sheets are normalised to 100 using the pinned rubric weights, then averaged per entry within its discipline and age group.
adminJudging.tieRule: Equal totals are decided by higher criterion means in descending weight (rubric order breaks equal weights), then the median sheet total. If still equal, entries share a rank and the next rank skips a place.
adminJudging.liveRanking: Provisional ranking. Scores and assignments can still change.
adminJudging.scoringCount: {assigned} assigned sheets; {unscored} not complete or no longer eligible.
adminJudging.lockLead: Locking freezes the ranking and prevents all further scores and assignment changes. Every assigned sheet must be eligible and complete.
adminJudging.overrideHelp: Explain why the missing or ineligible scores can be omitted, in 10–500 characters. Do not include participant details.
adminJudging.tagLead: Ranked and medal schemes prefill places 1–3; grades start untagged. Change each outcome if needed. Auction suitability is independent of auction consent.
adminJudging.noRanked: No entries have complete eligible scores yet.
adminJudging.medianTie: Tie broken by median sheet total
adminJudging.unscoredLead: No complete eligible sheet: these entries have no rank, even when an admin overrides the lock.
adminJudging.sourceHelp: Choose FOA-verified entries or the advancing outcomes of a round in the same competition. A linked round waits for its source to lock.
adminJudging.waitingForSource: Waiting for the source round to lock. No entries can advance yet.
adminJudging.advancingCount: {count, plural, one {# advancing outcome} other {# advancing outcomes}} in the locked source round.
adminJudging.finalistRule: Winners, runners-up and finalists can advance. Admit eligible entries to apply this round’s verification and physical-artwork rules.
